faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHAI Draftsman recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NHAI Draftsman position is 16-10-2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Draftsman post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Draftsman post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 75,000 per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration for the contract period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum experience requirements for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum of 5 years of professional experience. Additionally, a minimum of 3 years of experience specifically in drafting drawings of structures and tunnels is required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NHAI Draftsman jobs?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Draftsman position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Draftsman post is 45 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NHAI Draftsman recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two main stages: Scrutiny/Screening of applications, followed by an Interview or assessment by a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates with a Diploma in Civil Engineering apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a Diploma in Civil Engineering are eligible to apply, provided they also meet the other educational and experience criteria, including proficiency in CAD software.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this NHAI recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this Draftsman position is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is based in New Delhi, Delhi. Candidates should ensure they are willing and able to relocate or commute to this location if selected.
